TRU-04 validates data inputs, preventing malicious entries. TRU-05 mandates two-factor authentication, enhancing user security. TRU-06 logs user access for transparency. TRU-07 restricts data access based on roles, ensuring users only view relevant information. These requirements collectively guarantee security and instill user trust in the system.

requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
The system shall log all financial transactions with timestamps and user identifiers.
The system shall ensure an audit trail is maintained for at least 7 years.
The system shall validate data input to prevent unauthorized or malicious entries.
The system shall implement role-based access control and multi-currency support.
The system shall support two-factor authentication for all user access.
The system shall implement error handling mechanisms during transaction processing.
The system shall allow users to report ethical concerns confidentially.
The system shall ensure that all transactions are processed within 2 seconds.
The system shall utilize efficient data structures to optimize memory usage.
The system shall implement caching to reduce latency by at least 50%.
The system shall generate financial reports in under 5 seconds.
The system shall implement fault-tolerant logging mechanisms.
The system shall support document digitization to reduce paper usage by at least 80%.
The system shall implement mechanisms for users to detect potential discrepancies.

conflict_resolutions.rationale: The requirement for a 7-year audit trail was maintained for safety and regulatory compliance.
The logging delay is maintained at 1 second while allowing for efficient logging mechanisms.
The logging requirements are decomposed into maintaining accountability and ensuring efficiency through fault-tolerant mechanisms.
The logging system will integrate energy-efficient algorithms while maintaining performance.
